svg.title: The fold in three places
svg.desc: Seekers spell the same word many ways. roman_norm folds a Roman word in five steps — letter substitutions, digraphs, voicing pairs, the y glide, vowels dropped and doubles collapsed — into a key such as vhgr. The data repository applies it when it builds the translit_norm column; the platform applies it at query time in search and verification; the iOS app carries a Swift port. The contract file golden_roman_norm.ndjson records 24,719 input and output pairs generated from the platform, and every repository asserts against it.
